data.narrative:
Rhoman Aerospace is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Thomas Youmans and Thomas Callen. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public defense-tech firms, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a $250M total-raised proxy as the base, applies a typical 2.5x seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implying a valuation of $625M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $531M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $812M. The wide dispersion among peer valuations—spanning nearly two orders of magnitude—reflects meaningful uncertainty around stage characterization, technology maturity, and investor appetite within frontier defense. Key uncertainties include the sustainability of current investor valuations in this sector and the materiality of technology differentiation relative to the peer set.
